quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokić on Christian Braun's defensive impact and physicality
quotes.excerpt: he knows how to play a little bit dirty too. So he has he has a little bit of everything.
quotes.quote: He is good, you know. He is really athletic, he can beat people to the spot. He is kind of trippy, he knows how to play a little bit dirty too. So he has he has a little bit of everything.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jokic likes the edge Christian Braun brings to the Nuggets defense saying he knows how to play a little bit dirty and has a little bit of everything

structured.context: Nikola Jokić discusses the defensive impact and physicality of his teammate Christian Braun during a media availability session.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokić on the second unit's competitive drive
quotes.excerpt: they want something to prove, they are fighting for the spots, they are fighting for the minutes.
quotes.quote: They definitely they want something to prove, they are fighting for the spots, they are fighting for the minutes, they are fighting for the roster. I think that is amazing and it should be like that. Especially the guys who are playing really well, they should have more minutes.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jokic says the Nuggets second unit is fighting for roster spots and minutes and believes guys who are playing well should earn more time

structured.context: Nikola Jokić comments on the competitive drive and motivation of the Nuggets second unit players during practice.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Murray on Christian Braun's aggressive defensive presence
quotes.excerpt: he is coming in being aggressive no matter what the refs are calling, no matter what the tone is.
quotes.quote: He is just coming in being aggressive no matter what the refs are calling, no matter what the tone is. So I like that. He is coming in setting the tone with the second unit. He guards me in practice and he just really does a good job with denying and making it tough to get the ball.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Murray says Christian Braun is setting the tone for the second unit and making it tough to get the ball in practice

structured.context: Jamal Murray praises the aggressive defensive presence of Christian Braun during team practice sessions.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Murray on his motivation to make All-NBA teams
quotes.excerpt: thought I could have made All-Second Team, so striving for that and obviously want to keep the All-Star up.
quotes.quote: Obviously doing it over again and more. I thought I could have made All-Second Team, so striving for that and obviously want to keep the All-Star up, which means I got to have a good start. So really just taking game by game, but focusing on these wins early, I think are important.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Murray is motivated to make an All-NBA team this season after feeling he could have made All-Second Team last year

structured.context: Jamal Murray discusses his personal goals and motivation to earn All-NBA honors for the upcoming season.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Murray on the benefits of secondary ball-handlers
quotes.excerpt: having the ball in their hands, they will be more comfortable to go run the play or go make a play.
quotes.quote: I think it is not just me, I think it is everybody, especially when we get to the playoffs. They make a basket or whatever and I am going to deny with two people out of the out of bounds. I think everybody just having more comfortability bringing it up and getting to a set or just going to score and just playing freely. Just having the ball in their hands, they will be more comfortable to go run the play or go make a play.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Murray says the Nuggets are focusing on having more comfortability with secondary ball handlers to help the team play more freely

structured.context: Jamal Murray explains the benefits of having multiple players comfortable handling the ball and initiating the offense.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on the professionalism of DeMar DeRozan
quotes.excerpt: the reason why they have been good for so long like him, it is just the professionalism.
quotes.quote: You know, some of these guys, the reason why they have been good for so long like him, it is just the professionalism. And it is the way they attack every day. You know, we talk about that a lot here, not with cameras in the room, but just attacking what you are doing in the moment and he is the perfect example of that.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman praises DeMar DeRozan for his professionalism and the way he attacks every day

structured.context: Coach Adelman discusses the professionalism and work ethic of DeMar DeRozan during a media session.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on the impact of Aaron Gordon's return
quotes.excerpt: when Aaron plays, we are as good as any team in the league.
quotes.quote: When Aaron plays, we are as good as any team in the league. The way our defense changes, all of a sudden we are a big team. Offensively, he can be your lead ball-handler, he plays in the dunker, he shoots 40% from three, he is a great passer.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman says when Aaron Gordon plays the Nuggets are as good as any team in the league because of his versatility on both ends

structured.context: Coach Adelman explains the defensive and offensive impact that Aaron Gordon brings to the Nuggets lineup.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on the importance of spacing against OKC
quotes.excerpt: the further you are away from him the better off you are going to be.
quotes.quote: The spacing is going to be good because of the attention that Shai brings. You know, I think it is a lot of times Jokic is the same way. The further you are away from him the better off you are going to be because that is a longer rotation. And if we are bringing extra help to Shai or Jalen or whoever it is, you know, I think the spacing matters and their shooting matters.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman emphasizes the importance of spacing against OKC noting that the further you are from Shai Gilgeous-Alexander the better off you are

structured.context: Coach Adelman discusses the importance of spacing and defensive rotations when playing against the Oklahoma City Thunder.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Christian Braun's defensive value
quotes.excerpt: Christian is the core of our transition offense, the way he runs the floor.
quotes.quote: Christian is the core of our transition offense, the way he runs the floor, the way he can finish at the rim. And I think the explosion for me, it is going to be the defensive side of it. That means he is going to shut down Shai, but getting through pick and roll, getting through actions they run for Shai, there is an explosion part to that too.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman expects Christian Braun to be a key defensive factor against Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Thunder

structured.context: Coach Adelman details the defensive value and transition play that Christian Braun provides for the team.
